questions.question: Which .NET component executes managed code and provides services such as garbage collection?
questions.explanation: The CLR provides the runtime environment for managed code, including memory management.

questions.question: A C# local variable is declared as var count = 3;. What is its compile-time type?
questions.explanation: The compiler infers int from the integer literal. The type remains fixed.

questions.question: Which type represents a C# asynchronous operation that eventually returns an Order?
questions.explanation: Task<Order> represents an operation whose result, when awaited successfully, is an Order.

questions.question: Given string? name = null;, what does name ?? "Guest" evaluate to?
questions.explanation: The null-coalescing operator uses the right operand when the left operand is null.

questions.question: Which C# statements assign the value 5 to a variable declared as int? value;? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: Both the integer literal and int.Parse return an int that can be assigned to int?. The null assignment is legal but does not store 5.

questions.question: What is the purpose of using var stream = File.OpenRead(path); in a C# scope?

options.a: Reopen the stream on every read
options.b: Automatically run the reads on a background thread
options.c: Dispose the stream when execution leaves the scope
options.d: Load the entire file into memory immediately

questions.explanation: A using declaration arranges for Dispose to run at scope exit, including when an exception leaves that scope.

questions.question: Given a List<int> containing 1, 2, and 3, what sequence does values.Where(n => n > 1).Select(n => n * 2) produce when enumerated?
questions.explanation: Where first keeps 2 and 3. Select then doubles each remaining value.

questions.question: An ASP.NET Core service must share one instance among consumers within a request and use a separate instance in each request. Which built-in lifetime fits?
questions.explanation: ASP.NET Core normally creates a dependency-injection scope per request. A scoped service is reused within that scope.

questions.question: An ASP.NET Core middleware checks a request and then calls await next(context). What does next represent?

options.a: The next delegate in the request pipeline
options.c: The method that resets the current dependency scope
options.d: A timer that resumes the request after the response is sent

questions.explanation: Calling next passes control to the downstream pipeline. The middleware can resume after the awaited call completes.

questions.question: A request is canceled while a .NET service is awaiting downstream work. Which steps support cooperative cancellation? Select all that apply.

options.a: Start a fresh CancellationTokenSource without linking it
options.b: Pass the request's CancellationToken to APIs that accept it
options.c: Check the token inside a long-running loop
options.d: Catch cancellation and restart the canceled work immediately

questions.explanation: Cancellation must propagate to downstream operations. A long loop can check the token to stop promptly.

questions.question: An EF Core query loads Product entities for a read-only catalog. Which modifier tells EF Core to skip tracking these results?
questions.explanation: AsNoTracking omits change tracking for entity results of the query, which suits read-only use.

questions.question: An EF Core DbContext loads a tracked customer entity. The application changes its name and calls SaveChangesAsync(). What does EF Core normally do?

options.b: Persist the tracked change to the existing row
options.d: Detach the entity before detecting changes

questions.explanation: With normal change detection enabled, EF Core identifies the modified tracked entity and writes the update.

questions.question: Which C# keyword rethrows the current exception from a catch block while preserving its original stack trace?
questions.explanation: The bare throw statement rethrows the current exception while retaining the original stack trace.

questions.question: A C# program awaits Task.WhenAll(loadProfile, loadOrders). When does the returned task complete?

options.b: As soon as the first supplied task succeeds
options.c: When the tasks are added to a queue
options.d: Only when both operations return the same type of value

questions.explanation: WhenAll completes after every supplied task has finished. The final state reflects any fault or cancellation.

questions.question: Which statements describe standard .NET collection behavior? Select all that apply.

options.a: A Queue<T> removes items in insertion order
options.b: A Stack<T> removes items in insertion order
options.c: A List<T> can contain duplicate elements
options.d: A HashSet<T> keeps repeated equal entries as separate items

questions.explanation: A queue is FIFO and a list allows duplicates. A stack is LIFO, while a hash set keeps one entry per equality class.

questions.question: How can an ASP.NET Core application give a service strongly typed access to a section of configuration?

options.a: Store the configuration section as a static int
options.b: Register the service as a background worker
options.c: Bind the section to an options class and inject IOptions<T>
options.d: Convert the settings into route parameters

questions.explanation: The options pattern binds configuration to a typed object and makes it available through dependency injection.

questions.question: Which C# declaration allows a derived class to replace an ordinary base method's implementation through an override?

options.d: Declare the base method as an extension method

questions.explanation: A virtual instance method can be overridden. Runtime dispatch then selects the implementation for the actual object.

questions.question: A LINQ query over a List<T> must be evaluated now so later list additions do not change which items the result contains. Which method materializes the result into a list?
questions.explanation: ToList enumerates the source and stores the resulting items immediately. Where and Select typically defer enumeration.

questions.question: Which ASP.NET Core component can use a route template such as /products/{id} to select a handler?
questions.explanation: Endpoint routing matches the incoming request to registered endpoints using route patterns and other constraints.

questions.question: Which actions are appropriate when handling an asynchronous database call from ASP.NET Core? Select all that apply.

options.a: Block on the task with .Result to release the request thread
options.c: Run concurrent operations through the same EF Core DbContext
options.d: Pass the request cancellation token if the API accepts it

questions.explanation: Await avoids synchronous blocking and the token propagates cancellation. A single DbContext does not support concurrent operations.
